item.title: Toyota To Build Kei Trucks In America Via The Scion Brand
item.description: Toyota building kei trucks in North America probably wasn’t something in your Bingo cards this year, but that’s exactly what has happened with the return of Scion. Now known as “Scion by Toyota,” its first product is the Kei-01 (stylized as KEI-01). Read More »

item.title: Geely Opens In Zamboanga City
item.description: Geely Motor Philippines (GMP), together with dealer partner Otto-Motto Mobility, Inc. (OMMI), officially opened Geely Zamboanga. Read More »

item.title: iCaur Extends V23, V27 Pre-Sales Offer, Doubles Limited-Edition Pioneer Edition To 200 Units Per Model
item.description: In response to the strong start to the pre-sales of the iCaur V23 and V27 Pioneer Edition, the new energy vehicle brand has announced that it will extend its Pioneer Edition offer until November 24, 2026, or until the allocation has been filled. Read More »

item.title: Li Auto Appoints New Philippine Distributor
item.description: The mystery surrounding the fate of Li Auto has finally been solved. Dangdang New Energy Auto Service takes over the distributorship of the premium Chinese new energy vehicle brand made formal in an official signing ceremony. Read More »

item.title: GWM Philippines Recorded Third Consecutive Month Of Record Sales
item.description: GWM Philippines recorded its third consecutive record sales month in October 2026 and crossed 1,000 units sold for the year, with year-to-date sales now at 1,282 units.
